limitations: MREC two-region table without GSI; sampled timing is not an AWS guarantee.
No inference of concurrent ordering from same-second CloudTrail events.

The custom-role authority probe uses a nonexistent owned-name role rather than creating a role. Error establishes replication role PassRole denial; trust-policy and arbitrary custom-role effective execution were not measured. Preexisting default role succeeds and is never mutated.
Two-region MREC without a GSI; no MRSC, legacy global tables, real scaling workload, or CloudWatch alarm firing was exercised.

CloudTrail queries are bounded and eventually delivered. EventSource application-autoscaling.amazonaws.com yielded no events (323-324); corrected EventName lookups capture actual autoscaling.amazonaws.com events. Query results exclude unrelated resources and redact all access-key/session credential fields.
Some tool calls were interrupted before a native result (explicit excludedEvidence entries); complete subsequent snapshots are used instead. Cleanup polling interruption did not interrupt a mutation.
Partial-error repetitions establish differing observed outcomes from prior evidence, not universal determinism. No input-specific cleanup or concurrent action ordering is inferred.
STS federation creates no persistent IAM resource; 900-second credentials remained memory-only, were redacted before persistence, and expire automatically.

evidence.finding: A registered read target without policies projects as AutoScalingDisabled:true and ScalingPolicies:[] with bounds/role omitted; the AS target still exposes bounds, role, creation time and ARN.

Custom PolicyName is honored. Alpha-to-beta-to-gamma replacement removes the old named policy and installs the requested name/configuration while preserving the read scalable target ARN and creation time; native policy ARN changes with name.

Multiple target-tracking policies were not production-reachable on this DynamoDB read dimension: a second policy on the same metric rejects; custom metrics reject; the write predefined metric on a read dimension rejects. No multi-policy projection semantics are invented.

Individual AS DynamicScalingInSuspended, DynamicScalingOutSuspended, ScheduledScalingSuspended, and all three true do not set DynamoDB AutoScalingDisabled. Complete DDB replacement preserves all three suspended flags and target identity rather than enabling them.

Explicit default AutoScalingRoleArn succeeds. A nonexistent custom role fails via the replication service-linked assumed-role actor's iam:PassRole authority, not via the caller; malformed role ARN also fails. Neither error changed observed AS targets or policies. A federated caller explicitly denied both iam:PassRole and application-autoscaling:* still successfully updates DDB with explicit default role, while direct AS describe denies.

AutoScalingDisabled:true requires MinimumUnits, MaximumUnits and ScalingPolicyUpdate to be absent; valid or semantically invalid values cannot accompany disable. Shape validation (missing TargetValue) can reject before the disable-combination check. Role alone is not forbidden: true plus malformed AutoScalingRoleArn succeeds by deregistering the target, ignoring that role value.

AutoScalingDisabled false and omission both require complete MinimumUnits, MaximumUnits and ScalingPolicyUpdate; empty and single-missing-bound combinations reject. Complete false re-enables a new target/policy after deregistration.

Invalid global write bounds plus valid east2 read is non-atomic. Both new named-policy repeat and exact prior264 unnamed input repeat retained the valid east2 read policy and changed bounds after ACTIVE, unlike prior capture264's missing read policy. Therefore missing successful-sibling policy is not a stable unconditional rollback rule. Observations do not establish exact concurrent delete/put ordering or all possible outcomes.

Valid global writes plus invalid east2 read TargetValue101 retained updated write policies in both regions, but deleted the failed read policy while preserving its target and changing its bounds. This outcome occurred for named and exact prior285 unnamed input repetitions; not an atomic API rollback.

Captured dependent RegisterScalableTarget/PutScalingPolicy use AWSServiceRoleForDynamoDBReplication invokedBy replication.dynamodb.amazonaws.com. CloudTrail events are available for DeleteScalingPolicy as well. Event timestamps have whole-second granularity and cannot order same-second actions.

Both owned regional tables, all scoped scalable targets/policies, and owned alarm-prefix resources were explicitly deleted and absence verified; no IAM resources were created and shared roles were never modified.
